known_issues: Page loads very slowly and does not proceed past the 'Berechtigungen werden geprüft' (permissions check) screen; admin area not loading correctly

existing_features.title: Resolve the indefinitely-hanging 'Berechtigungen werden geprüft' (permissions check) loading state on the AdminDashboard page. The page must complete its permission check quickly and either grant access to the admin area or redirect/show an error — it must not remain stuck indefinitely.

Ensure the `useIsCallerAdmin` hook always resolves to a definitive value (true, false, or error) within a reasonable timeout, even when the backend actor is slow to initialize or the user is unauthenticated. Add a hard timeout fallback so the hook never stays in a pending state indefinitely.

Ensure the `useActor` hook initializes deterministically and does not silently stall. If actor creation fails or the identity is not yet available, the hook must surface an error or return a stable null/undefined state promptly so dependent hooks and pages can react accordingly.

projectName: Fix slow loading / stuck permissions check on Admin Dashboard
